# What bd 1.2.2 reads a value for, per command: recorded from the help of
# every command `bd --help` lists, three levels deep (the subsections of
# `bd <command> --help`, then theirs). Refresh it after a bd upgrade with
#     go run ./cmd/bdshim-record -flags
# which walks bd's help and writes this file; add -check to report drift
# without writing, and update internal/bdshim/flags.go to match.
#
# persistent<TAB>the value flags bd puts on every command (bd --help, Flags:),
#     left out of each command row because every command has them
# alias<TAB><name><TAB>the command path bd reads that name as ("new" is create)
# value<TAB><command><TAB>the flags bd reads a value for, space separated
# bool<TAB><command><TAB>the flags bd reads as a boolean or an optional value
#     here (--deps takes its value only after an =) although another command
#     reads a value for the same flag
persistent	--actor --database --db --directory --dolt-auto-commit --mem-profile -C
alias	backup add	backup init
alias	backup rm	backup remove
alias	dep rm	dep remove
alias	done	close
alias	find-dups	find-duplicates
alias	formula primitives	formula schema
alias	hb	heartbeat
alias	mol fart	mol bond
alias	new	create
alias	protomolecule	mol
alias	stats	status
alias	view	show
value	admin cleanup	--older-than
value	admin compact	--batch-size --id --limit --summary --tier --workers
value	audit label	--label --reason
value	audit record	--error --exit-code --issue-id --kind --model --prompt --response --tool-name
value	batch	--file --message -f -m
value	blocked	--exclude-label --label --label-any --parent -l
value	close	--if-assignee --if-status --reason --reason-file --session -r
value	comment	--file
value	comments add	--author --file -a -f
value	compact	--days
value	config show	--source
value	conflicts resolve	--strategy --table
value	conflicts show	--table
value	cook	--mode --prefix --search-path --var
value	count	--assignee --closed-after --closed-before --created-after --created-before --desc-contains --id --label --label-any --metadata-field --notes-contains --priority --priority-max --priority-min --status --title --title-contains --type --updated-after --updated-before -a -l -p -s -t
value	create	--acceptance --append-notes --assignee --body-file --context --defer --deps --description --design --design-file --due --estimate --event-actor --event-category --event-payload --event-target --external-ref --file --graph --id --labels --metadata --mol-type --notes --parent --priority --repo --skills --spec-id --status --storage-class --title --type --waits-for --waits-for-gate --wisp-type -a -d -e -f -l -p -s -t
value	create-form	--parent
value	defer	--reason --until
value	delete	--from-file --if-assignee --if-status
value	dep	--blocks -b
value	dep add	--blocked-by --depends-on --file --type -t
value	dep list	--direction --type -t
value	dep tree	--direction --format --max-depth --max-rows --status -d
value	doctor	--check --migration --orchestrator-duplicates-threshold --output -o
value	dolt commit	--message -m
value	dolt pull	--remote --strategy
value	dolt push	--remote
value	duplicate	--of
value	epic close-eligible	--reason -r
value	events export	--limit
value	events prune	--before

value	export	--exclude-owner --output -o

value	formula lint	--search-path
value	formula list	--type
value	gate check	--limit --type -l -t

value	gate discover	--branch --limit --max-age -a -b -l
value	gate list	--limit -n
value	gate resolve	--reason -r
value	graph	--max-rows
value	help	--doc --docs-root
value	history	--limit
value	human dismiss	--reason
value	human list	--status -s
value	human respond	--file --response -r
value	import	--input -i
value	init	--agents-file --agents-profile --agents-template --backend --destroy-token --prefix --remote --role --server-host --server-port --server-socket --server-user -p
value	land-record	--conflicting-file --gate-result --gate-tail --gate-tail-file --kind --landed-commit --om-findings --om-score --om-verdict --patch-id --route
value	link	--type -t
value	lint	--status --type -s -t
value	list	--assignee --closed-after --closed-before --created-after --created-before --defer-after --defer-before --desc-contains --due-after --due-before --exclude-label --exclude-type --external-contains --external-ref --format --has-metadata-key --id --label --label-any --label-pattern --label-regex --limit --max-rows --metadata-field --mol-type --notes-contains --offset --parent --priority --priority-max --priority-min --sort --spec --status --title --title-contains --type --updated-after --updated-before --wisp-type -a -l -n -p -s -t
value	merge-slot acquire	--holder
